990001.name: Vale Serra Outpatient Metabolic Survey
990001.description:
Dataset: Vale Serra Outpatient Metabolic Survey.

Cross-sectional survey run in 2031 by the fictional Vale Serra regional clinic network to plan a diabetes and cardiovascular prevention program. Adults seen in routine outpatient check-ups were measured by nurses with calibrated scales and automatic blood-pressure monitors; blood was drawn after an overnight fast and analysed in the network's central laboratory, and physical activity and sleep were self-reported in a short questionnaire. Each row is one adult patient.

Columns:
- age_years: age of the patient, in years (typical range 24 to 81).
- bmi_kg_m2: body mass index, in kg/m2 (typical range 19.9 to 34.8).
- activity_min_week: self-reported moderate or vigorous physical activity, in minutes per week (typical range 64 to 328).
- sleep_hours: self-reported average sleep per night, in hours (typical range 5.6 to 8.7).
- systolic_bp_mmhg: systolic blood pressure, in mmHg (typical range 99 to 147).
- fasting_glucose_mg_dl: fasting plasma glucose, in mg/dL (typical range 73 to 119).
- hba1c_pct: glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c), a three-month average of blood glucose, in % (typical range 4.5 to 6.1).
- ldl_cholesterol_mg_dl: LDL cholesterol, in mg/dL (typical range 76 to 166).

Known relationships: Glucose rises with BMI and with age and is a little lower in more active patients; HbA1c follows glucose closely; blood pressure rises with age and BMI; LDL cholesterol rises with age and BMI; heavier patients report less activity and slightly less sleep.

990002.name: Lumen Bay Household Energy Panel
990002.description:
Dataset: Lumen Bay Household Energy Panel.

Monthly panel of homes in the fictional coastal city of Lumen Bay, collected in 2030 by the city utility to size an efficiency subsidy. Consumption comes from smart meters, the bill from the utility's billing system, home and equipment data from an enrolment interview, and temperature from the nearest weather station. Each row is one household in one summer month.

Columns:
- household_income_k: annual household income, in thousand currency units (typical range 26.7 to 115).
- floor_area_m2: heated and cooled floor area of the home, in m2 (typical range 39 to 126).
- outdoor_temp_c: average outdoor temperature of the month, in degrees Celsius (typical range 21.5 to 30.8).
- ac_capacity_kw: installed air-conditioning capacity, in kW (typical range 1.34 to 4.5).
- appliance_age_years: average age of the main appliances, in years (typical range 1.2 to 13.7).
- solar_kwh_month: energy generated by rooftop solar panels in the month, in kWh (typical range 5 to 108).
- monthly_kwh: electricity drawn from the grid in the month, in kWh (typical range 162 to 521).
- monthly_bill: electricity bill of the month, in currency units (typical range 130 to 436).

Known relationships: Larger and richer homes use more energy; air conditioning drives consumption up on hot months; older appliances use more; solar generation reduces what is drawn from the grid; the bill is consumption times a tariff that varies between plans, plus a fixed fee.

990003.name: Rio Claro Smallholder Yield Monitoring
990003.description:
Dataset: Rio Claro Smallholder Yield Monitoring.

Field programme of the fictional Rio Claro agricultural cooperative (2029-2031) that follows maize plots of member farmers to advise on irrigation and fertilisation. Extension agents record inputs and soil tests, rain gauges on each farm record rainfall, and the harvest is weighed at the cooperative. Each row is one plot in one growing season.

Columns:
- season_rainfall_mm: total rainfall in the growing season, in mm (typical range 398 to 919).
- irrigation_hours: hours of irrigation applied in the season (typical range 7.4 to 57.5).
- fertilizer_kg_ha: nitrogen fertiliser applied, in kg per hectare (typical range 57 to 188).
- soil_ph: soil pH before planting (typical range 5.36 to 7.18).
- mean_temp_c: mean air temperature of the season, in degrees Celsius (typical range 20.1 to 28.2).
- pest_index: pest pressure score from field scouting (higher means more pests) (typical range 13.5 to 46.3).
- plot_area_ha: plot area, in hectares (typical range 0.52 to 3.34).
- yield_t_ha: harvested grain yield, in tonnes per hectare (typical range 1.18 to 4.79).

Known relationships: Yield increases with rainfall, irrigation and fertiliser, is highest near pH 6.5 and near 24 degrees, and drops with pest pressure; pests are worse in warmer seasons; plot size does not affect yield per hectare.

990004.name: Harbor Lane Online Grocery Customers
990004.description:
Dataset: Harbor Lane Online Grocery Customers.

Monthly customer summary of the fictional Harbor Lane online grocery service (2031), built from the shop's web analytics, the order system and an in-app satisfaction survey, to study loyalty. Each row is one active customer in one month.

Columns:
- customer_age: age of the customer, in years (typical range 21 to 77).
- distance_km: distance from the warehouse to the customer's address, in km (typical range 1.8 to 13.4).
- sessions_per_month: average number of shopping sessions per month (typical range 2.1 to 14.8).
- avg_session_minutes: average duration of a shopping session, in minutes (typical range 8 to 22.1).
- discount_pct: average discount received on orders, in % (typical range 1.3 to 14.6).
- delivery_hours: average time from order to delivery, in hours (typical range 3.6 to 15.6).
- monthly_spend: total amount spent in the month, in currency units (typical range 89.4 to 243).
- satisfaction_score: average satisfaction rating given in the app, from 0 to 10 (typical range 3.4 to 8.3).

Known relationships: Customers who shop more often, browse longer and get larger discounts spend more; younger customers shop more often in shorter sessions; deliveries to farther addresses take longer, and slower deliveries lower satisfaction.

990005.name: Kestrel Works Extrusion Line Log
990005.description:
Dataset: Kestrel Works Extrusion Line Log.

Hourly process log of a plastic-pipe extrusion line at the fictional Kestrel Works factory (2030), recorded by the line's control system and the quality lab, to plan preventive maintenance. Each row is one hour of production.

Columns:
- hours_since_maintenance: hours since the last preventive maintenance of the line (typical range 37 to 677).
- screw_speed_rpm: extruder screw speed, in revolutions per minute (typical range 64.7 to 105).
- ambient_humidity_pct: relative humidity in the hall, in % (typical range 35.5 to 73.3).
- barrel_temp_c: barrel temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 205 to 219).
- vibration_mm_s: gearbox vibration velocity, in mm/s (typical range 1.04 to 4.17).
- melt_pressure_bar: melt pressure at the die, in bar (typical range 173 to 207).
- motor_power_kw: motor power draw, in kW (typical range 40.1 to 53.5).
- defects_per_1000: defective pieces per 1000 produced, from the quality lab (typical range 4 to 29.4).

Known relationships: Vibration and barrel temperature creep up as time since maintenance grows; faster screw speeds raise temperature, pressure and power; defects increase with vibration, with temperature away from about 212 degrees and slightly with humidity.

990006.name: Northfield District Student Outcomes Study
990006.description:
Dataset: Northfield District Student Outcomes Study.

Study of the fictional Northfield school district (2031) linking school records and a family questionnaire to understand final-year exam results. Each row is one final-year student.

Columns:
- household_income_k: annual family income, in thousand currency units (typical range 21.6 to 109).
- prior_year_score: average grade in the previous school year, from 0 to 100 (typical range 40.7 to 81.6).
- study_hours_week: self-reported hours of study at home per week (typical range 2.2 to 13.8).
- attendance_pct: share of school days attended, in % (typical range 79.4 to 99.9).
- commute_minutes: one-way travel time to school, in minutes (typical range 8 to 47).
- sleep_hours: self-reported average sleep per night, in hours (typical range 6.3 to 9.2).
- extracurricular_hours: hours of extracurricular activities per week (typical range 0.7 to 9.7).
- final_exam_score: score in the final exam, from 0 to 100 (typical range 38.3 to 75.4).

Known relationships: Final scores rise with the previous year's grades, study time, attendance and sleep, and fall with long commutes; better previous grades come with more study and attendance; richer families' students had slightly higher previous grades; long commutes cut sleep.

990007.name: Marisol Coast Apartment Listings
990007.description:
Dataset: Marisol Coast Apartment Listings.

Listings of apartments for sale gathered in 2031 by the fictional Marisol Coast real-estate observatory from agencies in the region, to track housing affordability. Each row is one apartment listing.

Columns:
- floor_area_m2: private floor area, in m2 (typical range 34.2 to 128).
- distance_center_km: distance to the city centre, in km (typical range 2.2 to 16.2).
- building_age_years: age of the building, in years (typical range 4.2 to 43.9).
- walk_score: walkability score of the address, from 0 to 100 (typical range 0 to 86).
- street_noise_db: average daytime street noise at the facade, in dB (typical range 41.8 to 56.2).
- condo_fee: monthly condominium fee, in currency units (typical range 215 to 697).
- listing_price_k: asking price, in thousand currency units (typical range 120 to 624).
- days_on_market: days between listing and the observatory's snapshot (typical range 17 to 89).

Known relationships: Prices grow with area and fall with distance to the centre and with building age; central addresses are more walkable and noisier; condominium fees grow with area and are lower in older buildings; more expensive and more distant apartments stay longer on the market.

990008.name: Arden Valley Air Monitoring Network
990008.description:
Dataset: Arden Valley Air Monitoring Network.

Hourly readings from the fictional Arden Valley urban air-quality network (2030), combining reference analysers at roadside stations, a co-located weather mast and induction-loop traffic counters, used to issue pollution alerts. Each row is one station-hour.

Columns:
- traffic_vehicles_h: vehicles per hour on the adjacent road (typical range 238 to 1.76e+03).
- wind_speed_ms: wind speed, in m/s (typical range 0.6 to 8.1).
- temperature_c: air temperature, in degrees Celsius (typical range 11.5 to 31.2).
- humidity_pct: relative humidity, in % (typical range 44.6 to 85.8).
- pm25_ugm3: fine particulate matter PM2.5, in micrograms per m3 (typical range 3 to 16.4).
- pm10_ugm3: coarse particulate matter PM10, in micrograms per m3 (typical range 8 to 33.9).
- no2_ugm3: nitrogen dioxide, in micrograms per m3 (typical range 5.5 to 31.7).
- o3_ugm3: ozone, in micrograms per m3 (typical range 6.1 to 56.6).

Known relationships: Traffic raises PM2.5, PM10 and NO2, and wind disperses them; PM10 includes PM2.5 and tracks it closely; ozone forms on warm hours and is consumed by NO2; humidity is lower on warm hours.
